title: Code → Validation
outcome: Code is proven to do what the spec asked, by evals its builder never sees, and every change lands the same way.
why: A builder believes its own work, so its opinion isn't evidence. "Intent in, quality out" depends on an outside check.
proof: Every expected result has a pass or fail from an eval the builder never saw.
Every change lands reviewed, and a person approves the merge.
must_not: Let a builder grade itself, weaken a check to pass, or merge without a person.

touches.title: Test what the product does, with evals the builder never sees
Run a slice's eval on the built work, and give the verdict
Send each failure back as a handoff plan, to the builder or to a person
Run the evals again as the product changes
